notes: test_count is the assertion floor read by verify_all.sh B.4: B.4 runs .harness/scripts/check-sc-contracts.py and FAILs when fewer assertions PASS than this number, when the suite exits non-zero, or when this file is missing. It is a ratchet — adding assertions never breaks it, removing one costs an edit here in the same commit. passing_count equals it because the delivered suite passes every assertion it defines.
